readBy: Signal routine every 15 min, 9:45 AM - 3:15 PM ET (America/Toronto). Each run re-reads this file.
execution: Kiwi leads: orders are sent without waiting for K's go; K approves each one in the Questrade app. Every bot trades its strategy on every valid signal, subject to the risk block below (Risk Manager enforces).

risk.sizing: shares = floor(40 CAD / (|entry - stop| in CAD + est. fees per share)); then cap so the order's cost fits current Questrade buying power left after open positions. USD risk converted at data.json fees.usdcad.rate. If the capped size is under 1 share (or 1 spread), skip.
risk.dailyStopCheck: Before each order: today's realized loss + open risk to every working stop + this trade's risk must be <= 150 CAD. Once today's realized + unrealized P&L <= -150 CAD: no new orders, cancel working entries, flatten.
risk.stopOrders: Every entry goes with its stop (bracket or stop placed immediately after the fill). No averaging down, no widening stops.
risk.note: No desk-wide trade cap (K chose every valid signal); per-strategy caps below plus the 150 CAD daily stop bound the day. 150/40 = at most 3 full-size stop-outs before the stop is close.
risk.botBudgetsNote: Per-bot slices of the 150 CAD daily stop (sum = 150). A bot whose realized loss today + open risk + the new trade's risk would exceed its slice is blocked (risk_check.py prints the largest risk it can still take). Quant Lab's slice covers both its strategies. Options raised to 56 CAD on Nov 9, 2026 so one 40 USD spread fits; the desk-wide 150 CAD stop still applies on top, so slices now sum to 186 but the desk can never lose more than 150.

dailyBudget.rule: realized real loss today >= the bot's budget

stopoutGuard.rule: 3 or more stop-outs (real trades) in the bot's last 5 trading days

drawdownGuard.rule: sum of real R over the bot's last 20 real trades <= -4R

pauseRules.storedIn: data.json paused[] = {bot, rule, reason, since, until, setBy}; expired pauses move to pausedHistory[] and the trades before them no longer count for that rule

correlation.rule: Block a new trade when an open or pending position is in the same group AND the same direction (one bet per group). Also block when the 20-day daily-return correlation with an open same-direction position is > 0.8, computed from cached Questrade daily bars (bars/*.csv) when both tickers are cached; otherwise groups only.
correlation.matching: Tickers match on the root symbol (XIU.TO = XIU, CNQ.TO = CNQ). A ticker can be in more than one group.
correlation.notes: ZEB (equal-weight Canadian banks ETF) is in cdn_banks, not tsx_index (K marked it "?"); its correlation with XIU still triggers the 0.8 check when cached. QQC.TO (Nasdaq-100 in CAD) is in us_index.

risk.checkedBy: risk_check.py (every order, before it is sent)
risk.maxLossPerTradeCADByBotNote: Options Desk cap is 40 USD per spread (0.40 debit), per K on Nov 9, 2026; 40 USD x 1.396 USDCAD = about 56 CAD. Other bots use maxLossPerTradeCAD.
risk.openingGate: Set by Kiwi Nov 10 2026 EOD: while a position carried from a previous day is still open, send no new entries; the first order of the day is that position's exit. LIFTED Nov 13 2026 3:22 PM ET: UAL sold (account flat). Rule stays for any future carry.

strategies.entry: At the open: gap = open - prior close. If |gap| >= 0.75 x ATR14 (ATR from daily bars through yesterday), fade it: gap up -> short, gap down -> long, entry at the open price. Because the first routine run is 9:45 ET, enter at the 9:45 run only if price is still on the gap side of the open by <= 0.25 x gap (i.e. not already more than a quarter of the way to target) and still beyond the stop; otherwise no trade.
strategies.stop: One gap beyond the open: short stop = open + |gap|; long stop = open - |gap|.
strategies.timeStop: Exit at market 15:50 ET if neither stop nor target hit.
strategies.notes: Backtest assumes fill at the 9:30 open; a 9:45 fill is untested and will differ. HXT.TO duplicates XIU on most days: if XIU fires in the same direction, HXT is the second trade and doubles one bet (Risk Manager counts both against the 150 CAD stop). SHORTS need a shortable borrow in Questrade.

entry.orb: Opening range = high/low of 9:30-9:45 ET. LONG when a 5-min bar CLOSES above the OR high, with that bar's relative volume >= 1.5 (vs the same 5-min slot's 20-day average), price above session VWAP, and today's open above yesterday's close (trend filter). SHORT is the mirror (close below OR low, below VWAP, open below prior close). Only the first breakout of the day counts; skip if OR width > 1.0 x ATR14(daily) or < 0.1 x ATR14.
entry.vwap: After 10:30 ET: LONG when a 15-min bar closes back above VWAP after the prior bar closed below it (reclaim), RVOL >= 1.5 on that bar, and price above yesterday's close. SHORT when a bar closes below VWAP after closing above it (loss), RVOL >= 1.5, price below yesterday's close. First signal per ticker per day.

stop.orb: Opposite side of the opening range (long stop = OR low; short stop = OR high).
stop.vwap: Beyond the extreme of the signal bar and the bar before it (long: lower low of the two; short: higher high). Min stop distance 0.05% of price.

strategies.scan: 9:45 ET routine run: Whale Tracker reads get_quotes for the candidate list (watchlist + News Desk names + liquid US/TSX movers) and get_historical_data 15m for today's 9:30-9:45 bar of each. RVOL = that bar's volume / the 14-day mean of the same bar. Until 14 days of first-bar volumes are cached, use the proxy first-15-min volume / (14-day average daily volume x 0.12) (0.12 = median first-15-min share of daily volume on the 14 pilot days; marked rvolProxy). Top 5 by RVOL (>= 2.0) or with a fresh catalyst go on data.json watchlist (strategy "Stocks-in-play ORB", bot quant, reason "scout: whale").
strategies.entry: Opening range = high/low of 9:30-9:45 ET. Direction = the first 15-minute candle: close > open -> long only; close < open -> short only; doji -> no trade. LONG on a break above the OR high (stop-entry at OR high); SHORT on a break below the OR low. One entry per ticker per day, 9:45-15:15 ET.
strategies.stop: The other side of the 15-minute opening range (long stop = OR low; short stop = OR high). The 10%-of-ATR14 stop was removed on 2026-11-02 (decided by Kiwi).

strategies.notes: Stop changed 2026-11-02 (decided by Kiwi): the other side of the opening range only; the 10%-of-ATR stop is removed. Quick test (Questrade 5-min bars, SOFI/AMD/RIVN, 14 hand-picked high-volume days Jul 29 - Nov 2 2026): +0.54R per trade on 12 trades, 75% winners, net of slippage, SEC fee and FX - indicative only (tiny sample, days chosen with hindsight). strategies.name: News-catalyst momentum (pullback hold)
strategies.untestedWhy: No archive of timestamped headlines matched to intraday bars, so the rule can't be backtested with the data on hand.
universe: Any US or TSX stock with average daily volume >= 1M shares and price >= 5 (CAD/USD); no OTC, no halted names
strategies.entry: A fresh headline (company-specific: earnings, guidance, M&A, FDA, contract, analyst action; from the desk's news/X/filings sources) published <= 60 min before the signal. Price has moved >= 2% from the pre-headline price in the headline's direction, on relative volume >= 2.0. Wait for the first pullback: a 5-min bar that retraces toward VWAP or the 9-EMA but holds (closes above VWAP for longs / below for shorts), then enter on the break of that pullback bar's high (long) or low (short).
strategies.stop: Below the pullback low (long) / above the pullback high (short); skip if that is wider than 1.5 x ATR14(5-min) or if 40 CAD buys less than 1 share.
strategies.target: 2.0R; or trail the rest under each higher 5-min low after +1R.
strategies.timeStop: Exit if not at +0.5R within 45 min of entry; hard exit 15:50 ET.
strategies.notes: No trades into scheduled macro releases (economic calendar) or halts.

devils_advocate.rule: Before any News Desk entry the run writes a BEAR case (at least 3 concrete reasons the trade fails - e.g. the news is already priced in / the move is extended vs ATR, the broader market is weak or against the trade (SPY/QQQ direction, regime.json), the spread or liquidity is poor (bid/ask > 0.2% or thin size), a known event is near (macro release, halt risk), the headline is stale or second-hand) and a BULL case, then skips the trade unless the bull case clearly wins. Veto only: it can stop a valid signal, never create one or change size, stop or target.
devils_advocate.record: python3 debate.py --id <journal idea id> --bull "..." --bear "..." --bear "..." --bear "..." --verdict take|skip --why "..." (writes bull, bear, verdict on the idea in journal.json)
devils_advocate.enforced: risk_check.py --bot news requires --idea <id> with a debate whose verdict is take; otherwise BLOCK.

strategies.name: Defined-risk debit spreads
strategies.untestedWhy: No historical option-chain (bid/ask) data on hand; Questrade connector gives current chains only.
strategies.entry: Only as the options expression of another bot's valid signal on the same underlying (direction from that signal): buy a vertical debit spread (call spread for long, put spread for short), long leg at or 1 strike in the money, short leg 1-2 strikes out. Total debit x 100 x contracts + fees <= 40 USD (about 56 CAD; K's rule, Nov 9, 2026). Expiry >= 1 trading day out (no 0DTE) and <= 10 DTE. Each leg's bid/ask spread must be < 10% of its mid and open interest >= 500. Limit order at the spread mid (one 15-min re-price toward natural, then cancel).
strategies.stop: Max loss = debit paid (<= 40 USD, about 56 CAD); also close if the underlying hits the source signal's stop.
strategies.target: Close at +80% of the debit, or when the underlying hits the source signal's target.
strategies.timeStop: Close the spread by 15:45 ET (same-day only).
strategies.notes: 40 USD max loss means debits of 0.40 USD or less per spread. Counts as one open position; underlying signal and spread together count as two if both are taken.

promotionRule.rule: A strategy is active only if its walk-forward out-of-sample mean R is > 0 in most test windows (more than half of the windows that had trades) AND it has >= 20 paper or real trades in journal.json. Otherwise testing. Retire when OOS mean R <= -0.05 over >= 30 OOS trades (K confirms).
promotionRule.note: testing strategies still trade on every valid signal (K's every-signal rule); the status is a label plus the evidence bar.

modes.live: trades real money on every valid signal (risk_check.py can ALLOW)
modes.paper: log every signal as a journal idea (log_idea.py marks it mode=paper, taken=no) but never send a real order; risk_check.py always BLOCKs it with "paper-only: retired"
modes.howToName: Bots with more than one strategy (Quant Lab) must name it: risk_check.py --strategy orb|vwap|sip_orb; log_idea.py matches the --strategy text against each strategy's aliases (longest alias wins).
